items.body:
### What happened?

When k8s services startup, there are still some error message, and  'kubectl get pods -A' report many RESTARTS too.

RESTARTS:
```
+ kubectl get pods -A
NAMESPACE     NAME                            READY   STATUS    RESTARTS   AGE
kube-system   coredns-66f779496c-jnmdl        1/1     Running   10         7d16h
kube-system   coredns-66f779496c-vnj6z        1/1     Running   10         7d16h
kube-system   etcd-t7610                      1/1     Running   104        7d16h
kube-system   kube-apiserver-t7610            1/1     Running   82         7d16h
kube-system   kube-controller-manager-t7610   1/1     Running   90         7d16h
kube-system   kube-proxy-79s84                1/1     Running   10         7d16h
kube-system   kube-scheduler-t7610            1/1     Running   87         7d16h

- ```

### What did you expect to happen?

Can k8s services startup gracefully without any error message or RESTARTS ?

### How can we reproduce it (as minimally and precisely as possible)?

We just reboot/start the k8s with the OS reboot/start.

### Anything else we need to know?

_No response_
